items.title: VI Live: Domper voor PSV, Shakhtar komt vlak voor rust op voorsprong
items.summary: Landskampioen PSV gaat zijn verkregen Champions League-ticket voor het eerst verzilveren met een thuiswedstrijd tegen Shakhtar Donetsk. In deze VI Live volgen we het duel in Eindhoven op de voet.

items.title: VI Live: Roma breekt de ban, assist Malen
items.summary: De Champions League raast door, bij hoge uitzondering ook op de donderdag. Bayern München en Manchester United komen bijvoorbeeld in actie en Donyell Malen staat met AS Roma vroeg tegenover het Fenerbahçe van bijvoorbeeld Nathan Aké, Jayden Oosterwolde en assistent-trainer Dirk Kuijt.

items.title: Bosz verklaart reserveplaats Fernandez: 'Wil hem niet alles laten spelen'
items.summary: Peter Bosz staat met PSV voor een nieuw Champions League-seizoen. De Eindhovenaren trappen het miljardenbal in eigen huis af tegen Shakhtar Donetsk. De trainer gaf tekst en uitleg bij zijn basisopstelling en ging in op de tegenstander. En ook het onderwerp Ruben van Bommel kon niet onaangeroerd blijven.

items.title: Op deze manier kijk je gratis naar Champions League-duel tussen PSV en Shakhtar
items.summary: PSV begint de Europese campagne donderdag 10 september om 18.45 uur met een thuiswedstrijd tegen Shakhtar Donetsk. De Eindhovenaren stonden in 2024 ook al tegenover de Oekraïners. VI zet uiteen hoe je dit duel gratis kunt bekijken.

items.title: Opstelling PSV: Kostic vervangt geschorste Mauro, ook Wanner aan de aftrap
items.summary: PSV begint donderdag met Filip Kostic aan het nieuwe Champions League-avontuur. Peter Bosz kiest voor de Serviër als vervanger van Mauro Júnior, die ontbreekt door een schorsing. Paul Wanner speelt op het middenveld in plaats van de jonge Noah Fernández. Verder zitten er weinig verrassingen in de Eindhovense elf.

items.title: Why Kai Havertz’s dummy was perhaps more pleasing than a Lionel Messi waltz | Max Rushden
items.summary: The Arsenal striker reminded us grace can exist in the non-stop pace of football with his involuntary noise-provoking act During Covid, when sport was back but behind closed doors, I hosted a number of strange online shows to fill the void of real life. The highlight was chatting to Darren Gough about a lifesize bronze rhinoceros for 45 minutes to 15 small boxes on a Zoom call. I don’t recall who it was for and where the rhinoceros came from – but it might be in his garden. I ended up doing virtual pre-match corporate Zoom calls for Heineken before Europa League games. It was the wifi version of Club Wembley: a Q&A happening on stage between a generic host and some random ex-pro while you’re trying to chat to your mate and eat an unidentified square of meat with some dauphinoise potatoes. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Football saved Dad’s life’: meet the coach of the England women’s Parkinson’s team
items.summary: It began with getting her dad into walking football after his diagnosis – now Gemma Darvill is taking a national team on tour to Canada When Gemma Darvill’s dad, Les, was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease aged 58, joining a walking football team stopped him from confining himself to his own home, and she believes the game saved his life. What she could never have foreseen was that, eight years later, she would find herself coaching the first England women’s Parkinson’s team, helping transform the lives of women with the disease from all across the country. She is set to embark on a journey to Toronto to help spread awareness of the ways in which walking football can help put the brakes on the progression of Parkinson’s symptoms. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘That’s how it started’: Dambrauskas’ journey from Who Wants to Be a Millionaire to Champions League
items.summary: Valdas Dambrauskas takes Sabah to Manchester United after journeying from Lithuania and a game show win, via London pub work Valdas Dambrauskas can reel off the questions and answers without a moment’s pause. Who won the first Academy Award for best actor in 1929? It was Emil Jannings, even if someone else might have been tempted to go with Charlie Chaplin. Which country publishes the highest number of daily newspapers? India was the clear winner. Can you name the nation that produces the most electricity per capita in the world? His family, watching back home, clasped heads in hands but he was right: back then, in 2002, the answer was his native Lithuania. It was enough to win Dambrauskas about £725 in his appearance on Six Zeros – A Million, the Lithuanian version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? “At that time it was quite big money,” he says. “I could have bought a flat in my home town; it was a very difficult period there and they were almost free. But my plan was to go to England and follow my dream to become a coach, and that’s how it started.” Continue reading...

items.title: Chelsea’s 2016-17 Premier League title should be given to Spurs, says Pochettino
items.summary: Former manager says Chelsea should be stripped of title ‘The title should be for the team that was second’ Mauricio Pochettino says Chelsea should be stripped of their 2016-17 Premier League title for financial rule breaches and the honour retrospectively awarded to Tottenham, who he led to second place that season. Chelsea were fined £10m by the Football Association in July and given a suspended two-window transfer ban for multiple violations of the rules during the Roman Abramovich era. They were also fined £10.75m by the Premier League in March. Continue reading...

items.title: Sibierski is heel hard voor Mario Stroeykens: "Zal nog lang duren"

De boodschap van de Fransman is bijzonder hard voor een speler die jarenlang als één van de grote talenten van Neerpede werd beschouwd.

items.title: Spoedtransfer van JPL naar Nederland: "Ik moest 's avonds nog de namen van mijn ploeggenoten blokken"

De 25-jarige Belg werd op huurbasis weggehaald bij Cercle Brugge en kreeg meteen een bijzonder steile introductie in Tilburg. "Er komt in korte tijd heel veel informatie op je af", blikt hij terug in het Algemeen Dagblad.

items.title: Belgische voetbalbond neemt vlammend standpunt in, Frankrijk steunt

Dat hebben ze laten weten via een vlammend statement op de eigen webstek. Infantino gaf zondag aan wel degelijk een nieuwe ambtstermijn te ambiëren.

items.title: "Où se situe la limite ?" : un sélectionneur belge invite à une décision forte dans le cas Courtois
items.summary: Le cas Thibaut Courtois fait décidément beaucoup parler en sélection. Durant sa carrière d'entraîneur fédéral, le Belge Tom Saintfiet a connu des situations similaires et sait combien il est difficile de concilier les envies de chacun.

items.title: Alexis Mac Allister makes his point as Liverpool fight back to defeat Atlético
items.summary: It was the time and place for Alexis Mac Allister to do his talking on the pitch and the disgruntled Liverpool midfielder delivered on cue. “Very sad” over Liverpool’s refusal to offer him a new contract, while Dominik Szoboszlai and Ryan Gravenberch were getting theirs, Mac Allister made Anfield very happy with a match-winning display against Atlético Madrid. The Argentina international, one of five World Cup finalists involved in an absorbing, delicately-poised contest, vented his frustrations in the best possible and most professional way – from behind an immaculate 20-yard strike into Jan Oblak’s goal rather than a microphone. Mac Allister believes he is playing for a new deal this season and promised to give “100% to my last day” at the pre-match press conference. He was true to his word to extend Atlético’s winless sequence against English opposition in the Champions League league phase to 11 matches. Continue reading...
